posts.title: Why Am I So Tired If AI Is Doing All the Work?
posts.description: AI makes it easy to start more work. But reviewing it all still takes your time and attention. No wonder we’re so tired.

posts.title: The Brain Sandwich
posts.description: The brain sandwich is a practical AI coding workflow: understand the problem, let an agent help, then verify and explain its work before sharing it.

posts.title: AI Is Breaking This Thing We Call Trust
posts.description: AI-generated work can look finished without being understood. That uncertainty erodes trust, slows reviews, and leaves colleagues doing the missing work.
